purpose: Deterministic offline comparison on predeclared fictional authored-plan fixtures. It is not production traffic, observed user preference, or evidence of user-quality or engagement uplift.

evaluationProtocol.splitDesign: Development and heldout plan families are separate fixture files. Each split is evaluated as its own current public source corpus (development N=49; heldout N=24), preventing development-family documents from affecting heldout IDF or candidate ranks.
evaluationProtocol.queryProfiles: One exact current Like seed per predeclared intent family; each seed is evaluated separately; the seed item is excluded from ranking and pair denominators.
evaluationProtocol.labels: Hand-authored ordinal judgments from fictional fixture content: relevant, unrelated, ambiguous. Ambiguous cases are excluded from strict precision/recall/FPR and counted in a conservative precision denominator as false positives.

roleAwareV2Formula.tokenSelection: Distinct terms: retain strongest-role weight, sort by descending weight then lexical token, cap at 64 per source.
roleAwareV2Formula.documentFrequency: Computed from the same bounded current public source vectors; IDF = ln(1 + N / (1 + df)).
roleAwareV2Formula.similarity: Weighted Jaccard: sum(min(seedWeight,candidateWeight)) / sum(max(seedWeight,candidateWeight)), using IDF-adjusted weights.
roleAwareV2Formula.qualification: At least two distinct shared meaningful tokens and at least one shared identity token from name/event-title/idea-title on both sides; idea-notes-only matches do not qualify.
roleAwareV2Formula.score: Maximum qualifying seed similarity multiplied by 3, capped at 3; otherwise zero.

baseline.note: Non-personal baseline has no preference scores; binary affinity precision/recall are not applicable.

notesOnlyBoundaryProbe.description: Unlabeled two-source probe with shared body-note topic terms and no shared identity-role terms.

curatedUnlabeledDiagnostic.source: 17 current public curated starter fixtures; unlabeled legacy diagnostic only.

caveats: These are manually written fictional fixtures with family-based ordinal labels and selected ambiguous cross-family cases, not independently adjudicated real-user relevance labels; results describe only these cases.
The baseline has no affinity prediction. Its ranking precision at K is reported against the fixture judgments, but affinity precision/recall are not applicable.
V2 lowers false positives in this fixture set while losing many labeled relevant matches; this is a precision/recall tradeoff, not a demonstrated quality improvement.

The family-seed design is intentionally small and does not estimate independent-user variance; pairs sharing a seed are correlated and should not be treated as independent observations for confidence intervals or significance claims.
The corpus includes English, Spanish, mixed-language and unknown-language examples; it does not establish robust multilingual or semantic-paraphrase coverage.
Creator concentration, recency, and cursor traversal are deterministic fixture diagnostics only; they do not establish live exposure or engagement outcomes.

The heldout split was opened only after the v2 formula, threshold, and production policy fingerprint were locked; any later policy change requires a new validation split or must be reported as validation-informed iteration.
